name: Account shell
description: The signed-in frame: a section nav, a greeting header and a content pane, collapsing to a horizontal scroll nav on narrow widths.

name: Order history
description: Past orders as rows with order number, date, item thumbs, a status pill, the total and per-order actions.

name: Order detail
description: One order opened out: status, itemised lines, delivery address, payment summary, totals, and invoice, reorder and support actions.

name: Return request
description: A returns flow with per-item reasons, a refund or exchange choice, a comments field and a live summary of the refund.

name: Wishlist
description: Saved products with price, an availability line, move to cart and remove, plus the empty state when the last one goes.

name: Address book
description: Saved address cards with a default badge, edit and delete on an inline confirm, and an add-address form revealed by a button.

name: Payment methods
description: Saved card rows showing brand, masked last four, expiry, a default badge and an expired state, with an add-card form.

name: Subscription manager
description: An active subscription with a frequency select that moves the next delivery date, plus skip, pause and cancel.

name: Rewards panel
description: A points balance, a progress bar to the next tier, a redeem row that spends the balance, and a short points ledger.

name: Sign in and register
description: A two-tab panel with sign in on one tab and create account on the other, a forgot-password link and a guest option.

name: Password reset
description: The request form with its check-your-email confirmation, and a set-new-password form with a strength meter and match check.

name: Guest order lookup
description: An order number plus email form for customers without an account, with a found result and a not-found error state.
